notes: Single anonymous packet. Candidate start 2026-10-12T20:48:25.628Z. The trace covers about 16.5 minutes of activity (last event 243 at 21:04:57Z, last Observation write at event 246, 21:05:49Z) and 12 of 40 API requests, with none refused. Seen checks: HR01, HR03, HR12, HR14 (4/27). Saved checks: HR03, HR12, HR14 (3/27). Directly Journey-linked: none. No Observation is linked to a Journey, and the only Journey, 'Review an employee profile', has no Observations. Checkpoints, by complete support timing: 10 min (cutoff 20:58:25.628Z): seen HR01 (events 26, 64, 123), HR03, HR14; saved HR03 (Observation 30e47a26 at write event 52) and HR14 (Observations 0dcaff21 and b6f50cbd by write event 137). 20 min: adds seen and saved HR12 (Observation ed0d29c5 at write event 221, 21:03:22Z). 40 min and final: same as 20 min, 4 seen and 3 saved. Unsupported claims: 1 material (Observation 6347b74b, Approvals missing from Manager navigation) recorded by 10 min, and 1 non-material ('role' used for the job title). Material unsupported per saved complete check: 10 min 1/2, 20 min 1/3, 40 min 1/3, final 1/3. Partial useful facts that earn no complete check: Hannah's HR Admin navigation and dashboard counts (Observation 33d1f76c); directory total 28 across 3 pages with default Name ascending sort (HR07 and HR06 context); row-click access to employee detail /employees/7 for manager and HR (HR08 context, no direct load or refresh); New leave request form defaults and the readonly date pickers (HR09 and HR10 context); onboarding step 1 fields (HR18 context). Evaluator-noticed discrepancy, not a candidate discovery: Request history shows Aug 11 – Aug 12, 2026 for a request stored as 2026-08-11 to 2026-08-13 with 3 days. Transient and settled states: the directory search snapshots at events 48, 107 and 154 briefly show the search text with the old 28-row list before settling to one row. My Leave briefly shows 'Available balance …' (event 214) before settling to 18 days (event 217). The saved Observations report the settled states. No Scenarios were proposed. No paired-block statistics were computed, as instructed.

Second review: all four credited or raw-seen checks, both unsupported claims and the 23 uncredited IDs were rechecked against the packet trace UI, Product responses and attributed public Observation bodies. No support set, boolean or claim materiality changed. HR12 was assessed on its stated requirement (employee reads back a submitted request in request history and records the displayed details). It does not require in-run creation, which HR11 and HR17 cover, so the credit stands without a stricter alternative count. HR07 stays not seen because every directory request was page=1 and no paging action occurred. Raw Evidence was not used to fill facts missing from Observation bodies.
